suggestions: reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT dw2.i_category, dw2.i_class, dw2.i_brand, dw2.i_product_name, dw2.d_year, dw2.d_qoy, dw2.d_moy, dw2.s_store_id, dw2.sumsales, dw2.rk
FROM (
    SELECT dw1.i_category, dw1.i_class, dw1.i_brand, dw1.i_product_name, dw1.d_year, dw1.d_qoy, dw1.d_moy, dw1.s_store_id, dw1.sumsales,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dw1.i_category ORDER BY dw1.sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM (
        SELECT i.i_category AS i_category, i.i_class AS i_class, i.i_brand AS i_brand, i.i_product_name AS i_product_name,
               f.d_year AS d_year, f.d_qoy AS d_qoy, f.d_moy AS d_moy,
               st.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
               SUM(f.sumsales) AS sumsales
        FROM (
            SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk AS ss_store_sk,
                   d.d_year AS d_year, d.d_qoy AS d_qoy, d.d_moy AS d_moy,
                   SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
            FROM store_sales AS ss
            INNER JOIN date_dim AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
            GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_qoy, d.d_moy
        ) AS f
        INNER JOIN item AS i ON f.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        INNER JOIN store AS st ON f.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
        GROUP BY ROLLUP(i.i_category, i.i_class, i.i_brand, i.i_product_name,
                        f.d_year, f.d_qoy, f.d_moy, st.s_store_id)
    ) AS dw1
) AS dw2
WHERE dw2.rk <= 100
ORDER BY dw2.i_category, dw2.i_class, dw2.i_brand, dw2.i_product_name, dw2.d_year, dw2.d_qoy, dw2.d_moy, dw2.s_store_id, dw2.sumsales, dw2.rk
LIMIT 100
